meta.board: Vinyl ADC rev D (PCBWay, 4-layer, 1.6 mm, all THT) + Raspberry Pi 4B underneath

frame.origin: board lower-left corner (front-left, LED edge at y=0)
frame.z: up; 0 = top face of the HAT
frame.note: rot_deg is KiCad orientation (CCW positive seen from the top, page frame).

meta.confidence: Positions, holes, outline: exact from the .kicad_pcb. Pi geometry: Pi 4B model + render placement (matches the HAT hole pattern to 0.01 mm). Heights: KiCad 3D models unless "as_built" says otherwise; as_built values are photo estimates -> MEASURE.

holes.role: Pi 4 stack (HAT + Pi share this hole axis)

stack.note: Pi PCB top is 11.0 below the HAT bottom: 8.5 mm socket + 2.5 mm header body.

pcb.orientation: short axis along x, flush with the HAT right edge; SD end at y=71, USB/Ethernet end at y=156 (20 mm past the HAT back edge)

ports.name: USB-C power
ports.note: wall cut-out must pass the plug overmould up to the receptacle face

ports.name: micro-HDMI 0
ports.note: wall cut-out must pass the plug overmould up to the receptacle face

ports.name: micro-HDMI 1
ports.note: wall cut-out must pass the plug overmould up to the receptacle face

ports.name: 3.5 mm audio/composite
ports.note: wall cut-out must pass the plug overmould up to the receptacle face

microsd.faces: front (-y), on the Pi underside, under the HAT
microsd.note: Card tip at y~66.5 (socket mouth y~71), z -15.4..-14.6, card centre x~112. Not reachable from outside without a floor slot; removing the Pi is the normal route.

soc.note: BCM2711 heat source; sits under the HAT. Ventilate the floor below it.

pi4.power: 5 V 3 A via USB-C (right side wall). Pi 4 idles ~3 W, up to ~6 W.

leds.note: Centres are the optical axis (midpoint of the two pads), not the KiCad anchor (pad 1).

access.what: CLK SEL jumper 1x3 (1-2 XTAL, 2-3 GPCLK; currently 2-3)

keepouts.name: HAT top-side component envelope (as-built estimate, design to this)
keepouts.note: Tallest fitted parts are estimated at 16-17 mm (C1/C18 electrolytics, C20/C60 MKT boxes). Lid underside >= 22.0 keeps >= 2 mm over a 20 mm part.

keepouts.name: HAT solder side, lead protrusion (no Pi under it)
keepouts.note: THT leads are clipped to ~1.5-2.5 mm; the rework wires for U12 are on this side. Nothing may touch the copper side except the posts at the M3 holes.

keepouts.name: Raspberry Pi 4 (PCB + all parts incl. ports)
Pi underside parts (microSD socket/card, test pads)
Pi USB/Ethernet block (behind the HAT, rises above the HAT top)
Pi PoE 4-pin header tips (under the HAT, 1.0 mm below its copper side)
Terminal-block wire gutter (cables enter from -x)
keepouts.note: J20 / J3 / J60 wires enter horizontally from the left; keep 8 mm for the wire bend and ferrules.

keepouts.name: Test-point header probe clearance (J5, J22, J62, J1)
keepouts.note: Scope probe hooks need ~10 mm above the 8.5 mm pins: reached with the lid removed.
